question_fa: نرخ افسردگی دانشجویان را به تفکیک جنسیت و گروه سنی مقایسه کن.
sql:
SELECT
    gender,
    CASE
        WHEN age < 22 THEN 'Under 22'
        WHEN age < 26 THEN '22-25'
        ELSE '26+'
    END AS age_group,
    COUNT(*) AS total,
    SUM(depression_flag) AS depressed,
    ROUND(100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*), 2) AS depression_rate_pct
FROM student_depression
WHERE age IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY gender, age_group
ORDER BY gender, depression_rate_pct DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: برای روایت، ابتدا تفاوت جنسیت‌ها را نشان بده و سپس توضیح بده کدام گروه سنی در هر جنسیت ریسک بالاتری دارد.

question_fa: نرخ افسردگی شهرها را با میانگین کل مقایسه کن و شهرهای بالاتر از میانگین را نشان بده.
sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS overall_rate FROM student_depression), city_rates AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS total, 100.0 * SUM(depression_flag) / COUNT(*) AS city_rate FROM student_depression GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*) >= 100) SELECT city, total, ROUND(city_rate, 2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(overall_rate, 2) AS overall_rate_pct, ROUND(city_rate - overall_rate, 2) AS gap_pct FROM city_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE city_rate > overall_rate ORDER BY gap_pct DESC LIMIT 20;

question_fa: کشورها را بر اساس تغییر شیوع depression از ۱۹۹۰ تا آخرین سال رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH endpoints AS (SELECT country_name, MAX(CASE WHEN year = 1990 THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_1990, MAX(CASE WHEN year = (SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) THEN prevalence_pct END) AS value_latest FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE disorder = 'depression' AND is_country_like = 1 GROUP BY country_name), changes AS (SELECT country_name, value_1990, value_latest, value_latest - value_1990 AS change_pct_point FROM endpoints WHERE value_1990 IS NOT NULL AND value_latest IS NOT NULL) SELECT country_name, ROUND(value_1990, 3) AS value_1990, ROUND(value_latest, 3) AS value_latest, ROUND(change_pct_point, 3) AS change_pct_point, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY change_pct_point DESC) AS increase_rank FROM changes ORDER BY increase_rank LIMIT 25;

question_fa: برای depression، کشورهایی که آخرین مقدارشان بالاتر از میانگین جهانی است را رتبه‌بندی کن.

question_fa: دانشجوها رو با ساعت شبکه اجتماعی دسته‌بندی کن و نمره‌شون رو بده.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN social_media_hours < 2 THEN 'low_social' WHEN social_media_hours < 5 THEN 'mid_social' ELSE 'high_social' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(exam_score),2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating),2) AS avg_mental_health_rating FROM student_habits_performance WHERE social_media_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(social_media_hours);

question_fa: بر اساس ساعت خواب، نمره امتحان و سلامت روان رو مقایسه کن.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN sleep_hours < 6 THEN 'low_sleep' WHEN sleep_hours <= 8 THEN 'normal_sleep' ELSE 'high_sleep' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(AVG(exam_score),2) AS avg_exam_score, ROUND(AVG(mental_health_rating),2) AS avg_mental_health_rating FROM student_habits_performance WHERE sleep_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(sleep_hours);

question_fa: دانشجوها رو بر اساس ساعت کار/مطالعه دسته‌بندی کن و نرخ افسردگی بده.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN work_study_hours < 4 THEN 'lt_4' WHEN work_study_hours < 8 THEN '4_to_8' ELSE 'gte_8' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS depression_rate_pct FROM student_depression WHERE work_study_hours IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(work_study_hours);

question_fa: فشار مالی رو سه دسته کن و افسردگی هر دسته رو بده.
sql: SELECT CASE WHEN financial_stress <= 2 THEN 'low_financial' WHEN financial_stress <= 3 THEN 'mid_financial' ELSE 'high_financial' END AS bucket, COUNT(*) AS n, ROUND(100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*),2) AS depression_rate_pct, ROUND(AVG(cgpa_10),2) AS avg_cgpa_10 FROM student_depression WHERE financial_stress IS NOT NULL GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY MIN(financial_stress);

question_fa: سطح استرس عمومی رو دسته‌بندی کن و بهره‌وری هر دسته رو بده.

question_fa: روند افسردگی ایران رو سال به سال بده.
sql: SELECT year, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS depression_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name='Iran' AND disorder='depression' ORDER BY year;

question_fa: برای ایران تو آخرین سال، همه اختلال‌ها رو کنار هم بده.
sql: SELECT disorder, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS prevalence_pct FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE country_name='Iran' AND year=(SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long) ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC;

question_fa: شهرها رو با حداقل ۷۰۰ نمونه بر اساس نرخ افسردگی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT city AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS val FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=700) SELECT g, n, ROUND(val,2) AS depression_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rnk FROM s ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 15;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: رژیم‌های غذایی رو بر اساس نرخ افسردگی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT dietary_habits AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS val FROM student_depression WHERE dietary_habits IS NOT NULL GROUP BY dietary_habits HAVING COUNT(*)>=1) SELECT g, n, ROUND(val,2) AS depression_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rnk FROM s ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 15;

question_fa: دسته‌های خواب رو از نظر نرخ افسردگی رتبه‌بندی کن.
sql: WITH s AS (SELECT sleep_duration_category AS g, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS val FROM student_depression WHERE sleep_duration_category IS NOT NULL GROUP BY sleep_duration_category HAVING COUNT(*)>=1) SELECT g, n, ROUND(val,2) AS depression_rate_pct, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY val DESC) AS rnk FROM s ORDER BY rnk LIMIT 15;

question_fa: شهرهایی که نرخ افسردگیشون از میانگین کل بالاتره رو پیدا کن.
sql: WITH city_rates AS (SELECT city, COUNT(*) AS n, 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS rate FROM student_depression WHERE city IS NOT NULL GROUP BY city HAVING COUNT(*)>=500), overall AS (SELECT 100.0*SUM(depression_flag)/COUNT(*) AS overall_rate FROM student_depression) SELECT city, n, ROUND(rate,2) AS city_rate_pct, ROUND(overall_rate,2) AS overall_rate_pct, ROUND(rate-overall_rate,2) AS gap_pct FROM city_rates CROSS JOIN overall WHERE rate>overall_rate ORDER BY gap_pct DESC LIMIT 20;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: رتبه ایران برای هر اختلال تو آخرین سال چنده؟
sql: WITH r AS (SELECT country_name, disorder, prevalence_pct, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS rnk FROM country_prevalence_long WHERE year=(SELECT MAX(year) FROM country_prevalence_long)) SELECT disorder, ROUND(prevalence_pct,4) AS iran_prevalence, rnk AS iran_rank FROM r WHERE country_name='Iran' ORDER BY iran_rank;
storytelling_hint_fa: این query برای سنجش توان مدل در CTE/window/subquery مناسب است.

question_fa: برای آخرین سال جهانی، summary همه اختلال‌ها رو بده.
sql: WITH l AS (SELECT MAX(year) AS y FROM country_prevalence_long), r AS (SELECT disorder,country_name,prevalence_pct,RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY disorder ORDER BY prevalence_pct DESC) AS rk FROM country_prevalence_long,l WHERE year=y), s AS (SELECT disorder,AVG(prevalence_pct) AS avgp,MIN(prevalence_pct) AS minp,MAX(prevalence_pct) AS maxp FROM country_prevalence_long,l WHERE year=y GROUP BY disorder) SELECT s.disorder,ROUND(avgp,4) AS avg_prevalence,ROUND(minp,4) AS min_prevalence,ROUND(maxp,4) AS max_prevalence,r.country_name AS top_country FROM s JOIN r ON s.disorder=r.disorder AND r.rk=1 ORDER BY avg_prevalence DESC;
storytelling_hint_fa: نمونه پیچیده برای dashboard/storytelling و guardrailهای تحلیلی.
